entities.page_title: Blocked Bank Accounts and Financial Proof for Visa Applications
entities.topic: Proof of Financial Means for Visa Application (Blocked Account, Deed of Obligation, Scholarship)
entities.title: Blocked bank accounts
entities.summary: Explains the requirement for applicants to prove sufficient financial means when applying for a visa, primarily through a blocked bank account, with alternatives including a deed of obligation from a sponsor in Germany or a scholarship from HEC. From 1 January 2025, the required amount for a blocked account increases to €992.00 monthly or €11,904.00 yearly.
eligibility: Applicant must prove ability to meet living costs, e.g. via blocked bank account, deed of obligation, or HEC scholarship
Scholarship must be awarded by HEC; scholarships from Pakistani Universities are not sufficient
required_documents: Black-and-white copy of passport page 2 / page showing signature (for blocked account attestation)
Documents to open blocked account, signature attested by Embassy/Consulate/Honorary Consul
application_process: Open blocked bank account with a provider of choice that offers login code or contact for authorities to verify the account
Book attestation appointment at Embassy Islamabad, Consulate General Karachi, or Honorary Consul Lahore, bringing passport and signature page copy
Pay attestation fee directly at the Embassy
Book online appointment for visa application submission separately
For deed of obligation: sponsor in Germany appears before a Migration Office to declare and must prove sufficient financial means via payslips and bank statements covering at least 6 months
entities.application_fee: 25 Euros (about 5400 PKR) for attestation, may change due to exchange rate
important_notes: From 1 January 2025, the presumed annual requirement for blocked accounts increases to €992.00 monthly or €11,904.00 yearly, applying to all visa applications submitted from that date
Embassy and Consulate General reserve the right to request a blocked amount for up to two years in particular cases
Applicant must bring exact fee amount for attestation appointment or will need to reschedule
German Federal Foreign Office has no influence on decisions of the financial institution regarding the blocked account
A deed of obligation sponsor assumes responsibility for costs accrued in Germany in relation to the sponsored person
Only a scholarship awarded by HEC is accepted, not one from a Pakistani University

min_income_threshold.notes: Monthly equivalent is 992.00 Euros; applies to blocked account requirement for visa applications from 1 January 2025

extra_information.deed_of_obligation_min_financial_proof_p: 6 months of payslips and bank statements
